title: Virtual Screening-Based Drug Development for the Treatment of Nervous System Diseases.
authors: Li, Qian; Ma, Zhaobin; Qin, Shuhua; Zhao, Wei-Jiang
one_liner_zh: 综述虚拟筛选在神经系统疾病药物开发中的应用，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The incidence rate of nervous system diseases has increased in recent years. Nerve injury or neurodegenerative diseases usually cause neuronal loss and neuronal circuit damage, which seriously affect motor nerve and autonomic nervous function. Therefore, safe and effective treatment is needed. As traditional drug research becomes slower and more expensive, it is vital to enlist the help of cutting- edge technology. Virtual screening (VS) is an attractive option for the identification and development of promising new compounds with high efficiency and low cost. With the assistance of computer- aided drug design (CADD), VS is becoming more and more popular in new drug development and research. In recent years, it has become a reality to transform non-neuronal cells into functional neurons through small molecular compounds, which provides a broader application prospect than transcription factor-mediated neuronal reprogramming. This review mainly summarizes related theory and technology of VS and the drug research and development using VS technology in nervous system diseases in recent years, and focuses more on the potential application of VS technology in neuronal reprogramming, thus facilitating new drug design for both prevention and treatment of nervous system diseases.
abstract_zh: 近年来，神经系统疾病的发病率呈上升趋势。神经损伤或神经退行性疾病通常导致神经元丢失和神经元回路损伤，严重影响运动神经和自主神经功能。因此，需要安全有效的治疗方法。随着传统药物研发速度放缓且成本增加，借助尖端技术至关重要。虚拟筛选（VS）作为一种高效、低成本识别和开发有前景新化合物的有吸引力的选择，在计算机辅助药物设计（CADD）的辅助下，在新药开发与研究中日益普及。近年来，通过小分子化合物将非神经元细胞转化为功能性神经元已成为现实，这比转录因子介导的神经元重编程提供了更广阔的应用前景。本综述主要总结了VS的相关理论和技术，以及近年来VS技术在神经系统疾病药物研发中的应用，并重点关注VS技术在神经元重编程中的潜在应用，从而促进神经系统疾病预防和治疗的新药设计。
